content: A single moment of total awareness is more valuable than a lifetime of unconsciousness.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: What would it feel like to release the need to control the outcome of the next hour?
